categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang JW Precision Machinery Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of bearing rings, including ball, needle, and roller bearing rings. The company also produces screw rod components and is developing new products such as insulated bearing rings for electric vehicles and other applications. Its main products serve industries like automotive, engineering machinery, household appliances, and metallurgy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing processes including forging, cutting, turning, grinding, heat treatment, precision grinding, and non-destructive testing. It emphasizes process innovation and optimization, integrating energy-saving and material-saving designs. The firm invests heavily in R&D to develop high-precision manufacturing technologies and intelligent automated production lines, focusing on improving product quality and production efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major international bearing manufacturers such as Schaeffler, SKF, NSK, NTN, and JTEKT, as well as leading domestic bearing companies. The primary end markets include automotive (both traditional and new energy vehicles), engineering machinery, and other industrial sectors. The company’s products are widely used globally, with significant sales in domestic and overseas markets including Europe, North America, South America, and Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and production facilities in Quzhou, Zhejiang Province. It has established a global footprint through exports and customer factories located in multiple countries including Portugal, France, Slovakia, India, Canada, Japan, and Mexico. The company is also expanding its overseas presence by setting up new production facilities abroad.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang JW Precision Machinery operates primarily in the upstream to midstream segment of the bearing supply chain, focusing on the production of bearing rings and components. It supplies these critical parts to large bearing manufacturers who then assemble finished bearings. The company also provides processing services under entrusted manufacturing agreements.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on deepening its core bearing ring business while expanding into screw rod components and insulated bearing rings. It prioritizes talent development, innovation, and R&D to enhance manufacturing technologies and product quality. Key R&D initiatives include developing high-precision grinding processes, intelligent manufacturing, and new product lines for electric vehicles and automation industries.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of bearing rings and components to large bearing manufacturers, both domestically and internationally. Sales are conducted via direct orders, consignment inventory, and entrusted processing contracts. The company also earns revenue from new product development and occasional processing services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global bearing ring suppliers and is positioned as a specialized high-precision bearing ring manufacturer. It has established stable supply relationships with top international bearing companies, which enhances its competitive position. The industry is highly competitive with major players from Europe, Japan, and Sweden, but Zhejiang JW Precision Machinery leverages its technological and quality advantages to capture market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.15 billion, representing a 16% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 26.1 million, with some decline compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.39 billion, growing by nearly 8%. It maintains steady growth with ongoing investments in production capacity and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, precision manufacturing capabilities and stable product quality certified by ISO9001, IATF16949, and ISO14001 standards. It differentiates itself through advanced process innovation, strong R&D capabilities, and long-term partnerships with leading global bearing manufacturers. Its ability to provide customized, high-precision bearing rings and develop new products like insulated bearing rings for electric vehicles enhances its competitive edge.
